id:
Setelah turun ayat "Dan berilah peringatan kepada kerabat-kerabatmu yang terdekat" (QS. Asy-Syu'ara 214), beliau naik ke Bukit Shafa dan memanggil kabilah-kabilah Quraisy. Beliau bertanya, "Seandainya aku kabarkan ada pasukan berkuda di balik lembah ini yang hendak menyerang kalian, apakah kalian percaya?" Mereka menjawab, "Ya, kami tidak pernah mendapatimu berdusta." Beliau lalu bersabda, "Sesungguhnya aku adalah pemberi peringatan bagi kalian sebelum datangnya azab yang pedih."

Pelajaran: kejujuran yang dibangun bertahun-tahun menjadi modal utama dakwah.
en:
When the verse "And warn your closest relatives" (Qur'an 26:214) was revealed, he climbed Mount Safa and called the clans of Quraysh. He asked, "If I told you that cavalry behind this valley were about to attack you, would you believe me?" They said, "Yes, we have never known you to lie." He said, "Then I am a warner to you before a severe punishment."

Lesson: years of honesty became the foundation of his call.
